_comment: ADR-037 register fragment — agent-workspace. Adds the `Agent` and `AgentRun` schemas to the shared `buildiq` register. An Agent is a named, reusable, tool-scoped configuration layered on top of the existing ai-copilot plan/execute engine (design.md Context) — it never introduces a second execution engine (ADR-022/031): every agent-scoped plan/execute request still flows through CopilotService::plan()/execute() -> BuildiqToolProvider::invokeTool(). `enabledTools` is validated server-side at save time by restricting the array's `items.enum` to exactly the eight BuildiqToolProvider tool ids (REQ in specs/agent-workspace/spec.md 'Unknown tool name is rejected') — an unknown tool name fails OpenRegister's own JSON-Schema enum validation with no additional imperative code needed, matching ADR-031's declarative-first preference. The same eight-id enum is intersected server-side (never trusted from the client) with an agent's `enabledTools` on every plan/execute request (design.md Decision 1) — this schema-level enum only bounds what CAN be saved, not what is enforced at request time. AgentRun is the transparent run-log record (design.md Decision 2, Retool tool-chip transparency pattern) written by `AgentRunLogger`, a thin wrapper around CopilotService's existing plan/execute/discard paths — never embedded in CopilotService's core logic. `AgentRun` read access is RBAC-gated server-side (owners/editors only on the parent Application, design.md Open Questions) by the dedicated `AgentsController::runs()` endpoint, NOT by the generic OpenRegister object REST surface (that endpoint has no per-Application row-level filter, the same IDOR shape `routes.php`'s `applications#listMine` comment documents for the Application list).

Agent.title: Agent
Agent.description: A named, reusable, tool-scoped AI configuration for one Application: free-text instructions prefixed onto the copilot system prompt, an explicit subset of the eight BuildiqToolProvider tools it may invoke, and a per-run action cap. Never a wider capability surface than the bare copilot (agent-workspace design.md Goals).

applicationSlug.title: Application Slug
applicationSlug.description: Slug of the owning Application. An agent belongs to exactly one Application; plan/execute requests carrying this agent's id are always scoped to this Application server-side, never to a client-supplied appSlug.

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable name shown in the Agents list and as the chat panel's "acting as" header.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: Free-text instructions prefixed onto the copilot system prompt (CopilotPromptBuilder) for every plan request issued with this agent's id. Cannot widen the tool allow-list by construction (design.md Risks): the allow-list check is a server-side structural validation of the returned plan's tool names, not a trust boundary the prompt text can talk its way around.

modelTaskType.title: Model Task Type
modelTaskType.description: The `OCP\TaskProcessing` task type this agent targets. V1 default-inherits the bare copilot path's TextToText task type (design.md Open Questions): present on the schema now for a v1.1 follow-up once multiple task types are commonly configured.

enabledTools.title: Enabled Tools
enabledTools.description: The subset of the eight BuildiqToolProvider tool ids this agent may propose in a plan. Validated at save time against exactly this enum (an unknown tool name is rejected); re-validated server-side (intersected with the live catalogue) on every plan/execute request: never a superset of what the bare copilot already exposes.

maxActionsPerRun.title: Max Actions Per Run
maxActionsPerRun.description: Blast-radius cap independent of the global manifest caps (design.md Decision 4). A plan whose step count exceeds this value is rejected with 422 naming `max_actions_per_run`, the same rejection shape an over-cap manifest plan already uses.

AgentRun.title: Agent Run
AgentRun.description: One transparently-logged plan+execute (or plan+discard) interaction issued with an agentId (agent-workspace design.md Decision 2): the prompt, the returned plan, every tool call's arguments and result, and the final outcome. Written by `AgentRunLogger`, a thin wrapper around CopilotService's plan/execute/discard paths. Never a summarised or redacted view of what actually ran.

agentId.title: Agent UUID
agentId.description: UUID of the Agent this run belongs to.

applicationSlug.title: Application Slug
applicationSlug.description: Slug of the owning Application, copied from the Agent at write time so run-history RBAC never needs an extra lookup.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The user's natural-language brief for this turn.

plan.title: Plan
plan.description: The plan `{summary, steps[]}` returned by the plan step, echoed verbatim (empty/absent when the LLM output could not be parsed at all).

toolCalls.title: Tool Calls

arguments.title: Arguments
arguments.description: The arguments this tool call was invoked with.

result.title: Result
result.description: The handler's raw result envelope (success payload or `{isError, error, message}`).

toolCalls.description: Ordered list of every tool call this run dispatched through `BuildiqToolProvider::invokeTool()`, each with its arguments and raw result. The Retool tool-chip transparency pattern. Empty for a discarded or plan-rejected run.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: The final outcome of this turn: `applied` (every step succeeded), `rolled-back` (a mid-plan step failed and every snapshot was restored), `discarded` (the user reviewed the proposal and chose not to execute it), or `plan-rejected` (the plan failed allow-list/schema/maxActionsPerRun validation before any step ran).

createdAt.title: Created At
createdAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp this run record was written.
